Revelation 17:1 The state of the Church militant being declared, now followeth the state of the Church overcoming and getting victory, as I showed before in the beginning of chapter 10. The state is set forth in 4 chapters. As in the place beforegoing I noted, that in that history the order of time was not always exactly observed, so the same is to be understood in this history, that it is distinguished according to the persons of which it treateth, and that in the several stories of the persons is severly observed in the time thereof. For first is delivered the story of Babylon destroyed, in this and the next chap. (for this Babylon out of all doubt shall perish before the 2 beasts and the Dragon). Secondly is delivered the destruction of both the two beasts, chap. 19. And lastly of the Dragon, chap. 20, in the story of the spiritual Babylon are distinctly set forth the state thereof in this chap. and the overthrow done from God, chap. 18. In this verse and that which followeth is a transition or passage unto the first argument, consisting of a particular calling of the Prophet (as often heretofore) and a general proposition.
Revelation 17:1 That is the damnable harlot, by a figure of speech called hypallage. For S. John as yet had not seen her. Although another interpretation may be borne, yet I like this better.
Revelation 17:1 The sentence that is pronounced against this harlot.
Revelation 17:3 Henceforth is propounded the type of Babylon, and the state thereof in 4 verses. After a declaration of the type, in the rest of this chap., in the type are described two things, the beast (of whom chap. 13), in verse 3, and the woman that sitteth upon the beast, verses 4, 5, 6. The beast in process of time hath gotten somewhat more than was expressed in the former vision. First in that it is not read before that he was appareled in scarlet, a robe imperial and of triumph. Secondly, in that this is full of names of blasphemy: the other carried the name of blasphemy only in his head. So God did teach that this beast is much increased in impiety and injustice and doth in this last age, triumph in both these more insolently and proudly than ever before.
Revelation 17:3 A scarlet color, that is, with a red and purple garment: and surely it was not without cause that the Romish clergy were so much delighted with this color.
Revelation 17:4 That harlot, the spiritual Babylon, which is Rome. She is described by her attire, profession and deeds.
Revelation 17:4 In attire most glorious, triumphant, most rich, and most gorgeous.
Revelation 17:4 In profession, the nourisher of all, in this verse, and teaching her mysteries unto all, verse 5, setting forth all things most magnificently: but indeed most pernicious besotting miserable men with her cup, and bringing upon them a deadly giddiness.
Revelation 17:5 Deceiving with the title of religion, and public inscription of mystery: which the beast in times past did not bear.
Revelation 17:5 An exposition: in which S. John declareth what manner of woman this is.
Revelation 17:6 In manner of deeds: She is red with blood, and sheddeth it most licentiously, and therefore is colored with the blood of the Saints, as on the contrary part. Christ is set forth imbrued with the blood of his enemies; Isa. 3:1.
Revelation 17:6 A passage unto the second part of this chapter, by occasion given of S. John, as the words of the Angel do show, in the next verse.
Revelation 17:7 The second part or place, as I said, verse 1. The narration of the vision, promised in this verse, and delivered in the verse following. Now there is delivered first a narration of the beast and his story, unto verse 14. After, of the harlot, unto the end of the chap.
Revelation 17:8 The story of the beast hath a triple description of him. The first is a distinction of this beast from all that ever hath been at any time: which distinction is contained in this verse: The second is a delineation or painting out of the beast by things present, by which he might even at that time be known of the godly, and this delineation is according to his heads, verses 2, 10, 11. The third is an historical foretelling of things to come, and to be done by him: and these are ascribed unto his horns, verses 12, 13, 14. This beast is that Empire of Rome, of which I spake, chap. 13:11, according to the mutations and changes whereof which then had already happened, the holy Ghost hath distinguished and set out the same. The Apostle distinguisheth this beast from all others in these words. The beast which thou sawest, was and is not. For so I expound the words of the Apostle for evidence’s sake as I will further declare in the notes following.
Revelation 17:8 The meaning is, that beast which thou sawest before (Rev. 13:1) and which yet thou hast now seen, was, (I say was) even from Julius Caesar in respect of beginning, rising up, station, glory, dominion, manner and stock, from the house of Julius: and yet is not now the same, if thou look unto the house and stock for the dominion of this family was translated unto another, after the death of Nero from the other unto a third, from a third unto a fourth, and so forth was varied and altered by innumerable changes. Finally, the Empire is one, as it were one beast: but exceedingly varied by kindreds, families, and persons. It was therefore (saith S. John) in the kindred or house of Julius: and now it is not in that kindred, but translated unto another.
Revelation 17:8 As if he should say, Also the same that is, shall shortly not be: but shall ascend out of the depth, or out of the sea (as was said, Rev. 13:1) that is, shall be a new stock from amongst the nations without difference, and shall in the same state go unto destruction or ruin, and perish: and so shall successively new Princes or Emperors come and go, arise and fall, the body of the beast remaining still, but tossed with so many and often alterations, as no man can but marvel that this beast was able to stand and hold out, in so many mutations. Verily no Empire that ever was tossed with so many changes, and as it were with so many tempests of the sea, ever continued so long.
Revelation 17:8 That is as many as have not learned the providence of God, according to the faith of the Saints, shall marvel at these grievous and often changes when they shall consider, the selfsame beast, which is the Roman Empire, to have been, not to be, and to be and still molested with perpetual mutation, and yet in the same to stand and continue. This in mine opinion is the most simple exposition of this place, and confirmed by the event of the things themselves. Although by the last change also, by which the Empire, that before was civil became Ecclesiastical, is not obscurely signified by these words: of which two, the first exercised cruelty upon the bodies of the saints: the other also upon their souls: the first by human order and policy, the other under the color of the law of God, and of Religion, raged and imbrued itself with the blood of the godly.
Revelation 17:9 An exhortation preparing unto audience, by the same argument, with that of Christ: He that hath ears to hear, let him hear. Wherefore, for mine own part, I had rather read in this place, Let there be here a mind, etc. So the Angel passeth fully unto the second place of this description.
Revelation 17:9 Very children know what that seven hilled city is, which is so much spoken of, and whereof Virgil thus reporteth, And compasseth seven towers in one wall: that city it is, which when John wrote these things had rule over the kings of the earth: It was and is not, and yet it remaineth this day, but it is declining to destruction.
Revelation 17:9 This is the painting out of the beast by things present (as I said before) whereby S. John endeavored to describe the same, that he might both be known of the godly in that age, and be further observed and marked of posterity afterwards. This delineation hath one type, that is, his heads, but a double description or application of the type: one permanent from the nature of itself, the other changeable, by the working of men. The description permanent, is by the seven hills, in this verse, the other that fleeteth, is from the seven kings, verses 10, 11. And here it is worthy to be observed, that one type hath sometimes two or more applications, as seemeth good unto the holy Ghost to express either one thing by divers types, or divers things by one type. So I noted before, of the seven spirits, Rev. 1:4. Now this woman that sitteth upon seven hills, is the city of Rome, called in times past of the Greeks, … i. of seven tops or crests, and of Varro, septiceps, i. of her seven heads (as here) of seven heads, and of others, septicollis, i. standing upon seven hills.
Revelation 17:9 The beginning of these Kings or Emperors is almost the same with the beginning of the Church of Christ, which I showed before, Rev. 11:1. Namely from the year 35, after the passion of Christ, what time the Temple and Church of the Jews was overthrown. In which year it came to pass by the providence of God that that saying The beast was and is not, was fulfilled before that the destruction of the Jews immediately following came to pass. That was the year from the building of the city of Rome, 109, from which year S. John both numbered the Emperors which hitherto hath been, when he wrote these things, and foretelleth two others next to come: and that with this purpose, that when this particular prediction of foretelling of things to come, should take effect the truth of all other predictions in the Church might be the more confirmed. Which sign God of old mentioned this in the Law, Deut. 18, and Jeremiah confirmeth, Jer. 28:8.
Revelation 17:10 Whose names are these: the first, Servius Sulpicius Galba, who was the seventh Emperor of the people of Rome, the second Marcus Salvius Otho, the third Aulus Vitellius, the fourth, Titus Flavius Vespasianus, the fifth, Titus Vespasianus his son of his own name.
Revelation 17:10 Flavius Domitian son of the first Vespasian. For in the latter end of his days S. John wrote these things, as witnesseth Irenaus, Lib. 5 adversus hareses.
Revelation 17:10 Nerua. The Empire being now translated from the family of Flavius. This man reigned only one year, four months, and nine days, as the history writers do tell.
Revelation 17:11 This is spoken by the figure synecdoche, as much to say as that head of the beast which was and is not, because it is cut off, and Nerua in so short time extinguished. How many heads there were, so many beasts there seemed to be in one. See the like speech in Rev. 13.3
Revelation 17:11 Nerua Traianus, who himself in divers respects is called here the seventh and the eighth.
Revelation 17:11 Though in number and order of succession he be the eighth, yet he is reckoned together with one of these heads, because Nerua and he were one head. For this man obtained authority together with Nerua, and was Consul with him, when Nerua left his life.
Revelation 17:11 Namely, to molest with persecutions the Churches of Christ, as the histories do accord, and I have briefly noted, Rev. 2:10.
Revelation 17:12 The third place of this description as I said, verse 18, is a prophetical prediction of things to come which the beast should do, as in the words following S. John doth not obscurely signify, saying, which have not yet received the kingdom, etc. For there is an Antithesis or opposition between these kings, and those that went before. And first the persons are described, in this verse, then their deeds in the two verses following.
Revelation 17:12 That is, arising with their kingdoms out of the Roman beast: at such time as that political Empire began by the craft of the Popes greatly to fall.
Revelation 17:12 Namely, with the second beast whom we called before a false prophet, which beast, ascending out of the earth got unto himself all the authority and power of the first beast, and exerciseth the same before his face, as was said, Rev. 14:11, 12. For when the political Empire of the West began to bow downwards, there both arose those ten kings, and the second beast took the opportunity offered to usurp unto himself all the power of the former beast. These kings long ago, many have numbered and described to be ten and a great part of the events plainly testifieth the same in this our age.
Revelation 17:13 That is, by consent and agreement, that they may conspire with the beast, and depend upon his beck. Their story is divided into three parts, counsels, acts, and events. The counselors some of them consist in communicating of judgments and affections: and some in communicating of power, which they are said to have given unto this beast in this verse.
Revelation 17:14 With Christ and his Church, as the reason following doth declare, and here are mentioned the facts and the events which followed for Christ’s sake, and for the grace of God the Father towards those that are called, elected, and are his faithful ones in Christ.
Revelation 17:15 This is the other member of the narration as I said verse 7, belonging unto the harlot, showed in the vision, verse 3. In this history of the harlot, these 3 things are distinctly propounded, what is her magnificence in this verse, what is her fall, and by whom it shall happen unto her, in the two verses following: and lastly, who that harlot is, in the last verse. This place which by order of nature should have been the first, is therefore made the last, because it was more fit to be joined with the next Chap.
Revelation 17:15 That is, as unconstant and variable as the waters. Upon this foundation sitteth this harlot as Queen, a vain person upon that which is vain.
Revelation 17:16 The ten Kings as verse 12. The accomplishment of this fact and event, is daily increased in this our age by the singular providence and most mighty government of God. Wherefore the facts are propounded in this verse, and the cause of them in the verses following.
Revelation 17:17 A reason rendered from the chief efficient cause, which is the providence of God, by which alone S. John by inversion of order affirmeth to have come to pass, both that the Kings should execute upon the harlot, that which pleased God, and which he declared in the verse next beforegoing: and also that by one consent and counsel, they should give their kingdom unto the beast, etc., verses 13, 14. For as these being blinded have before depended upon the beck of the beast that lifteth up the harlot, so it is said that afterward it shall come to pass, that they shall turn back, and shall fall away from her when their hearts shall be turned into better state by the grace and mercy of God.
Revelation 17:18 That is, Rome that great City, or only City (as Justinian calleth it) the King and head whereof was then the Emperor, but now the Pope, since that the condition of the beast was changed.

text:
The Embassy of India in Azerbaijan organised a special painting exhibition on Baku’s Fire Temple and a reading session from Indian classic ‘Panchtantra’ at the Chancery premises in Baku on 18 October 2026, celebrating the rich artistic traditions of India and Azerbaijan and their longstanding cultural connections. The event brought together young Azerbaijani students and artists of different age groups for an engaging afternoon of art, literature, music and cultural exchange.

At the outset, Ambassador of India to Azerbaijan, H.E. Shri Abhay Kumar led the gathering on a tour of the Embassy’s permanent exhibition showcasing India’s UNESCO World Heritage Sites. The exhibition offered the participants a glimpse into India’s rich civilisational heritage, architectural marvels and cultural diversity, providing an enriching introduction to the country’s historical and artistic legacy.

Addressing the gathering, Ambassador Abhay Kumar, expressed happiness at the enthusiastic participation of Azerbaijani students and artists. He observed that art is one of the most powerful bridges between people and cultures, transcending language, geography and generations. He noted that both India and Azerbaijan are treasure troves of art, with rich artistic traditions reflecting their civilisational depth and cultural diversity. Appreciating the love for art in Azerbaijan, he said that the enthusiasm of young participants was particularly encouraging, as art inspires curiosity, fosters mutual understanding and brings people closer.

The Ambassador also highlighted the historical and cultural connections between India and Azerbaijan, noting that Baku’s historic Fire Temple stands as a remarkable reminder of these enduring links. The Swastika symbols, Devanagari inscriptions and representations associated with Indian traditions, including Lord Ganesha and Nataraja, offer fascinating glimpses into the cultural exchanges connecting the two countries across centuries. He emphasised that these connections are not merely part of their shared past but also serve as an inspiration for strengthening friendship between the two peoples.

The painting exhibition was a major attraction, featuring artworks by young Azerbaijani students and artists celebrating India’s rich cultural heritage and its historical links with Azerbaijan. The paintings depicted the Ateshgah Temple, Hindu deities, Indian people, traditional costumes and other aspects of India’s vibrant cultural landscape. The exhibition provided a creative platform for the participants to express their appreciation of Indian culture through their artistic interpretations.

An important highlight of the event was a special reading session led by Ambassador Abhay Kumar, who read two stories from the world-renowned Indian classic Panchatantra. The timeless tales, known for their engaging narratives and lessons in wisdom, friendship and practical life, were thoroughly enjoyed by the Azerbaijani children. The Panchatantra has travelled across cultures and generations and is widely known in Azerbaijan through ‘Kalila va Dimna’, a literary tradition that has captivated readers, including children, for centuries.
The programme also featured lively cultural performances by Azerbaijani artists dancing to Indian songs, adding to the festive atmosphere and showcasing the appeal of Indian music and dance among local audiences. The event concluded with a spread of Indian cuisine, offering participants a further taste of India’s diverse culinary traditions.

Through this initiative, the Embassy reaffirmed its commitment to promoting people-to-people contacts and cultural exchanges between India and Azerbaijan, particularly among younger generations. By bringing together art, literature, music and cuisine, the event celebrated the shared appreciation of culture that continues to strengthen the enduring friendship between the two countries.

MARK ZUCKERBERG TURNED DOWN $1 BILLION AT 22. STEVE JOBS TOLD HIM TO GO TO INDIA.

In 2006, Yahoo offered about $1 billion for Facebook. Mark Zuckerberg was 22.

Facebook was two years old, with roughly 8 to 9 million users. Two of his board members, Peter Thiel and Jim Breyer, reportedly thought he should accept.

He said no.

Years later, Zuckerberg told India's Prime Minister Narendra Modi a story he said he had never told publicly.

At a tough time for Facebook, with people around him debating whether to sell, he went to his mentor Steve Jobs.

Jobs told him to visit a temple in India that had helped shape his own thinking about what Apple should be.

Zuckerberg traveled for nearly a month. He says it reinforced the importance of what Facebook was doing.

He never sold. Meta is now valued at roughly $1.8 trillion.

Yahoo offered $1 billion. Steve Jobs offered a temple.

Would you have taken $1 billion at 22, or the ticket to India?

text:
There is only one place in the entire Bible where God describes Himself as doing something with all “His heart and with all His soul”. 

It is not an emotional metaphor. It is the deliberate reversal of the greatest demand ever laid upon humanity.

To any ancient reader, that phrase belonged to untouchable ground. It was the vocabulary of Deuteronomy, the ultimate demand laid upon human beings to offer undivided allegiance to their Creator. 

Yet the entire prophetic record is a catastrophic post-mortem of how thoroughly humanity failed that test. 

Israel proved utterly incapable of loving God with an undivided heart. Jeremiah himself spent decades diagnosing the problem, famously concluding that the human heart is deceitful above all things and desperately sick. The covenant demanded perfection, and Moses admitted in Deuteronomy 29:4 that the Lord had not yet given Israel a heart to understand.

Then comes Jeremiah 32:41, where the logic of the Shema is completely inverted. 

Facing a ruined nation on the brink of total annihilation, God takes the very demand humanity shattered and turns it upon Himself. 

He promises that He will rejoice in doing them good, and that “He will plant them in the land with all His heart and with all His soul”. 

In Hebrew thought, the heart is the seat of executive intellect and sovereign will, while the soul is the throat, the breath, and the living vitality. God invests His entire sovereign purpose and living delight in their restoration.

God effectively resolves the failure of Sinai by taking up both sides of the covenantal ledger. In the Old Covenant, the human party carried the burden of faithfulness, and they broke it. In Jeremiah 32, God eliminates the single point of failure. 

On His side of the ledger, He binds His own heart and soul to relentless goodness. On the human side, He declares that He will put the fear of Him in their hearts so that they may not turn from Him. (Jer 32:40)

The eternal security of the covenant no longer hangs on the fragile thread of human willpower, because God Himself renovates the human interior from within, securing an everlasting covenant in the blood of Christ so that the promise belongs irrevocably to His people.

Interestingly, God gave this prophecy while Babylonian siege ramps were banked against the walls of Jerusalem, while famine raged inside, and while Jeremiah sat locked in a royal prison, a long way from Solomon's golden temple at the peak of national prosperity. 

Moments before this declaration, God had the prophet spend seventeen shekels of silver to purchase an ancestral plot of land in Anathoth, territory already given into enemy hands. It was an economically absurd investment in a doomed country. Yet the deed was sealed in an earthen jar because God was looking straight through the coming fire to the harvest on the other side.

Most people move through life under the quiet, exhausting suspicion that God merely tolerates them through clenched teeth, as if grace were an awkward administrative concession. Jeremiah 32:41 dismantles that caricature entirely. 

The God of Scripture holds back no part of His nature in the work of redemption. The security of anyone who belongs to Him rests on the scandalous reality that God has committed His mind, His breath, and His infinite joy to never letting them go.

**Illinois has directed substantial state taxpayer resources to non-citizens ineligible for most federal benefits (primarily undocumented immigrants, plus some asylum seekers, TPS holders, and others), with the large majority of targeted spending occurring under Gov. J.B. Pritzker since he took office in January 2019. The biggest documented categories are medical care and migrant crisis support (housing, food, resettlement).**

Precise aggregate totals for all categories since 2019 are not published in one official state figure because spending is spread across programs, mixes of state/federal funds, and normal operations (e.g., public schools). The most widely cited compilation comes from the Illinois Policy Institute, which projects that Illinois will have spent **over $2.5 billion** on migrant care by the end of 2025, primarily health care plus welcome centers, housing, emergency food, resettlement, and rental assistance.

The largest specific programs are the **Health Benefits for Immigrant Seniors (HBIS, ages 65+)** launched around 2020 and **Health Benefits for Immigrant Adults (HBIA, ages 42–64)** expanded around 2022. These provide Medicaid-like coverage using primarily state funds to non-citizens ineligible for federal Medicaid due to immigration status.

A February 2025 Illinois Auditor General performance audit found:
- Combined spending of just under $898 million for FY2021–FY2023.
- Additional roughly $719 million in FY2024.
- **Total since inception through FY2024 of just over $1.6 billion.**

Later budgets included hundreds of millions more (e.g., ~$629 million appropriated for related coverage in the FY2025 period). Facing budget pressures, Pritzker’s administration ended the adult (42–64) program effective around July 1, 2025, while continuing a reduced seniors program. Emergency care and other residual access remain available under different rules.

### Housing, Food, Resettlement, and Related Support
In response to the post-2022 influx of asylum seekers (many bused from border states), Illinois created the **Welcoming with Dignity** initiative. Comptroller data show roughly **$478.7 million** allocated in the FY2023 and FY2024 budgets for items including Illinois Welcoming Centers, Chicago asylum-seeker supplements, emergency rental assistance, food and shelter grants, resettlement services, and related programs (mix of state general funds and some federal money).

Additional state commitments (including $160 million and $182 million rounds) supported shelters, intake, and wraparound services. Chicago itself reported about $640 million in total migrant crisis spending from August 2022 through the end of 2024 (housing ~46,000 people across shelters), with a substantial share coming from state and other grants alongside city funds.

### Education
- **K–12**: Undocumented children have a longstanding constitutional right to free public education (*Plyler v. Doe*). There is no separate “undocumented education” line item; costs are embedded in normal per-pupil spending. Advocates have estimated extra needs for newcomer students in the tens to low hundreds of millions; one analysis has put the annual cost attributable to undocumented students in Illinois in the hundreds of millions to over $1 billion depending on enrollment and average spending assumptions. Illinois recently passed additional state protections codifying access and limiting certain enforcement actions in schools.
- **Higher education**: Illinois has long offered in-state tuition (and later some state aid via the RISE Act and related programs) to certain undocumented students who met residency/high-school criteria. 

The bulk of the special health programs and the migrant crisis spending occurred from ~2020–2025 under Pritzker. Pre-2020 costs were much lower.

text:
CULTURAL DEBUTS 🎭

═══════════════ ❧ ════════════════

A Cultural Time Capsule ⋆ October 18, 2026

────────────── ◈ ───────────────

Music ⋆ Television ⋆ Film & Animation ⋆ Publishing & Literature ⋆ Theatre ⋆ Radio ⋆ Games & Other Cultural Firsts

────────────── ◈ ───────────────

“Every author, as far as he is great and at the same time original, has had the task of creating the taste by which he is to be enjoyed.” — William Wordsworth, 1815

────────────── ◈ ───────────────

THE CURTAIN RISES. THE CLOCK TURNS BACK. THE MAGIC BEGINS!

“To produce a mighty book, you must choose a mighty theme.” — Herman Melville, Moby-Dick, Chapter 104 (1851).

Some dates keep their secrets in plain sight. Today, a book arrives wearing the wrong name, and a night at the movies turns into the start of a habit. A very old tale is told again in a very new way, an ordinary kitchen becomes must-see television, and a handful of famous strangers agree to be nobody in particular. One story carries a farewell its maker never saw delivered, and another is still sung by people who have never asked where it began. You may know the songs, the faces, and the titles. You may not know how any of it started. Read on, and see what October 18 has been holding back.

THE PAST IS CALLING. THE MEMORIES ARE ALIVE. LET’S RELIVE THE MAGIC!

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🎵 MUSIC DEBUTS & MILESTONES

1988 — Traveling Wilburys Vol. 1 Is Released

On Tuesday, October 18, Traveling Wilburys Vol. 1 reached U.S. stores, with the UK release following on October 24. The group (George Harrison, Jeff Lynne, Bob Dylan, Roy Orbison and Tom Petty) had come together in April 1988 to record a bonus track for a Harrison European single. “Handle with Care” proved too good for a B-side, so the five agreed to make a full album. Recorded under the guise of the “Wilbury brothers,” it peaked at No. 3 on the Billboard 200. Wikipedia

🧩 TRIVIA: The musicians’ real names appear nowhere on the album, in its liner notes, or in the songwriting credits. Wikipedia

🧬 HUMAN: Orbison died suddenly of a heart attack on December 6, 1988, less than two months after the release, while the album was still riding high on the charts. His lead vocal on “Not Alone Any More” was his main contribution to the record. That song and the recognition after his death marked what one account calls a full return from the career downturn he had endured since the mid-1960s. Wikipedia

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

📺 TELEVISION PREMIERES & FIRST APPEARANCES

1988 — Roseanne Premieres on ABC

On Tuesday, October 18, Roseanne premiered on ABC, introducing the Conners, a working-class family in the fictional town of Lanford, Illinois, struggling to get by on a limited income. Built around stand-up comedian Roseanne Barr, whose “domestic goddess” stage persona producers Marcy Carsey and Tom Werner reshaped into a working-class heroine, the show offered a sharp contrast to the stereotypical TV housewife of June Cleaver and Carol Brady. It finished its first season ranked second in the Nielsen ratings and stayed in the top five for its first six seasons. HISTORY

🧩 TRIVIA: In the pilot, the Conners’ son D.J. was played by Sal Barone. Michael Fishman took over the role for the rest of the series. Wikipedia

🤫 SPOILER: The Conners returned in a revival in March 2018, but ABC cancelled it in May after Barr posted a tweet the network condemned. The family carried on without her in The Conners, which premiered that October and ran until 2025. Wikipedia

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🎬 FILM RELEASES, PREMIERES & ANIMATION

1922 — Robin Hood Premieres at Grauman’s Egyptian Theatre

On Wednesday, October 18, Grauman’s Egyptian Theatre opened on Hollywood Boulevard with Douglas Fairbanks in Robin Hood as its opening attraction. The AFI Catalog records that date as the film’s Hollywood opening. The evening is often described as the first motion-picture premiere held in Hollywood, a distinction credited to this film in later accounts. The silent epic, produced by Fairbanks for United Artists, was accompanied by an orchestral score he specially commissioned. A huge castle and an entire 12th-century Nottingham village were built at the Pickford-Fairbanks Studio for the production. AFI Catalog

🧩 TRIVIA: Fairbanks is credited as the author of the story under the pseudonym “Elton Thomas.” Wikipedia

🏆 BONUS: The Film Year Book 1922-1923 named the film one of the year’s “Ten Best,” and the Library of Congress survival database lists it as extant, so modern audiences can still see it. AFI Catalog

· · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · ·

1961 — West Side Story Premieres in New York

On Wednesday, October 18, the screen version of the 1957 Broadway musical had its world premiere at New York’s Rivoli Theatre. The Los Angeles premiere followed at Grauman’s Chinese Theatre on December 13. Robert Wise and Jerome Robbins, who had directed and choreographed the stage original, co-directed this retelling of Romeo and Juliet among rival teenage gangs on Manhattan’s Upper West Side. United Artists released it as a deluxe roadshow, one of only six 1961 releases to get that treatment and one of only three released with 70mm prints. It became the highest-grossing film of 1961 and won 10 of its 11 Academy Award nominations. Google Arts & Culture

🧩 TRIVIA: Most of the New York-set film was shot on sound stages in West Hollywood. The exteriors filmed on location included condemned buildings on West 61st Street, in an area now occupied by Lincoln Center. Cinema Sightlines

🧐 CURIOSITY: The October date was chosen so the film would be eligible for the Oscars held in April 1962. Google Arts & Culture

· · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · · ·

1967 — The Jungle Book Is Released

On Wednesday, October 18, Disney’s The Jungle Book was released, roughly ten months after Walt Disney’s death. Directed by Wolfgang Reitherman and based on Rudyard Kipling’s Mowgli stories, it was the last animated feature Disney supervised. The voice cast mixed screen and music veterans: Phil Harris as Baloo, Sebastian Cabot as Bagheera, Louis Prima as King Louie and George Sanders as Shere Khan. The finished film favored songs and character over Kipling’s darker tone. D23

🧩 TRIVIA: Early versions of the script and songs followed Kipling closely and darkly, which Disney did not want, so writer Bill Peet and composer Terry Gilkyson were replaced. Gilkyson’s “The Bare Necessities” nonetheless stayed in the film alongside five songs by the Sherman Brothers. Wikipedia

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

📚 PUBLISHING & LITERARY FIRSTS

1851 — Moby-Dick Is Published in London as The Whale

On Saturday, October 18, London publisher Richard Bentley issued Herman Melville’s novel in three volumes under the title The Whale, in a printing of only 500 copies. Bentley’s edition censored or changed sensitive passages, and by one account the finished book looked quite different from what Melville had intended after he sent proofs with his own revisions. The American edition, a single volume titled Moby-Dick; or, The Whale, followed from Harper & Brothers on November 14. Literary Hub

🧩 TRIVIA: Melville’s total earnings from the book came to just $556.37. Literary Hub

🧐 CURIOSITY: Not every word debuted that day. The chapter “The Town-Ho’s Story” had already appeared in Harper’s New Monthly Magazine in October 1851. Wikipedia

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🎭 STAGE & CULTURE

2001 — Mamma Mia! Opens on Broadway

On Thursday, October 18, after previews that began on October 5, Mamma Mia! officially opened at the Winter Garden Theatre. It brought to Broadway the ABBA-powered musical that had premiered at London’s Prince Edward Theatre on April 6, 1999. With songs by Benny Andersson and Björn Ulvaeus, a book by Catherine Johnson, and direction by Phyllida Lloyd, it follows a bride on a Greek island who invites three possible fathers to her wedding. IBDB records 5,758 Broadway performances before its September 12, 2015 closing, including a move from the Winter Garden to the Broadhurst Theatre in November 2013. IBDB

🧩 TRIVIA: The musical’s title comes from ABBA’s 1975 chart-topper “Mamma Mia.” Wikipedia

🏆 BONUS: As of October 2017, it was the ninth-longest-running show in Broadway history and the longest-running jukebox musical there. Wikipedia

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🎬🎵 AND WHAT A SHOW IT’S BEEN! 🎸📺

October 18 is a day of retellings. Melville’s whale first surfaced in London as The Whale, a few weeks before its American edition carried the name we now know. Shakespeare’s star-crossed lovers moved to a Manhattan street corner in West Side Story, and Kipling’s jungle was softened into a Disney musical, a last gift from a founder who did not live to see it open. A Hollywood theater turned a swashbuckler into a night out, while ABBA’s hit records found a second life on a Broadway stage. In a Lanford kitchen, Roseanne retold the American family from a working-class table, and five famous musicians slipped into the Wilbury family, with a voice that was soon silenced and is still heard. None of these works began as the monument it later became. They changed form, title, and medium, and each retelling gave a story one more life that its creators could not have planned.

✨ THE YEARS MOVE ON. THE MEMORIES NEVER FADE. THE MAGIC LIVES FOREVER! 🎭🎶

DAW Books, which published the Gor series from the 8th volume (Hunters of Gor) to the 25th volume (Magicians of Gor), subsequently decided to cease publication of the books, citing low sales;[8]

According to Betsy Wollheim, who took over DAW Books from her father Donald A. Wollheim in 1985,

I alone killed the Gor books. I am personally responsible for rejecting John Norman. ... I am very proud of that. We needed him in the beginning because he sold so well. The head of New American Library came up to me and said "Why aren't you publishing him?" I said, "Hey, he's yours. Go. Do it. You want to publish him, publish him." If you accuse a publisher of censorship every time they reject a manuscript, then by that definition every manuscript submitted would have to be published. Books would be terrible. A publisher has to have some sort of editorial discretion.[9]

Norman attributed the decision to feminist influences, saying in 1996:

Tarnsman of Gor was published in late 1966. It has been reprinted 22 times... I have recently signed contracts for fresh French and German sales, and have recently been published for the first time in Czechoslovakia. There have been recent Spanish and Italian sales. There's no evidence that my books no longer sell... After DAW refused to buy any more Gor books, I sold a three-part Telnarian series to Brian Thomsen of Warner Books. The first book, The Chieftain, had a 67 percent sell-through. The second, The Captain, had a 91 percent sell-through, which is the sort of thing that would make Stephen King rush over to shake your hand... Brian Thomsen, my Warner editor for the Telnarian series... was replaced by an editor from one of the blacklisting presses, one that explicitly informed my agent they would not consider anything by John Norman. That new editor canceled the series despite its success and without waiting to see how the third book, The King, would do. That way things are made nicely clear...

Unfortunately for me, only about seven or eight publishing houses maintain a mass-market paperback line in science fiction and fantasy; this small, closely-knit group effectively controls the market. With such a group, a blacklist need not be an explicit, formal written or oral agreement subscribed to by a gathered cabal pledged to secrecy. It is an understanding that a certain individual is to be ostracized, excluded, methodologically overlooked or such.[10]

"Hello, I am Palestinian. 🇵🇸
And since honesty is so rare in my politics, let me confess a few things.

1947. The UN offered me a state. Alongside Israel. Borders, independence, recognition. I said no. My leaders promised that war would "drive the Jews into the sea." Instead, I lost everything and they called it a catastrophe. Not because they didn't offer me a state, but because I rejected it.

1948–2025. Arab states could have integrated me, given me rights, passports, dignity. Instead, they locked me in refugee camps for generations, so I would remain a weapon against Israel. They built palaces for themselves and prisons for me. They used me as propaganda, not as people.

1967. After another lost war, I could have built a state in the West Bank and Gaza. Instead, I insisted on "no peace, no recognition, no negotiations." Three noes. Fifty years later, I still have no state. Turns out, rejection doesn't pay the rent.

Oslo, 1990s. Israel said: "Let's try it." It gave me autonomy. Weapons for the police. Billions in aid. What did my leaders do? They stole the money, armed militias, and launched an intifada. Suicide bombings instead of schools. Rockets instead of factories.

Gaza, 2005. Israel left completely. No settlers, no soldiers. I had the chance to turn Gaza into a Mediterranean Singapore. I voted for Hamas. They turned it into Mogadishu by the sea. Billions in aid? Tunnels, rockets, and palaces for their leaders, while my people eat canned food in the dark.

Democracy? I haven't had elections in nearly 20 years. Hamas kills dissenters in Gaza. Fatah imprisons them in the West Bank. My leaders cancel elections because they're too busy fighting for power.

Religion. Instead of building a future, I put clerics on TV teaching children to hate Jews. I glorify "martyrs" who blow up buses. I raise my children with songs of blood and fire instead of books and science. I trade hope for holy war.

Arab world. Arab regimes call me "brother." But ask them how many Palestinians can live freely in Lebanon, Syria, Egypt, or Kuwait. They exclude me, but celebrate my death, because my death is their excuse.

Absurdity. I keep saying I want to "build a state." And ironically, right next door is Israel: the neighbor that built a thriving democracy, a tech powerhouse, farms in the desert, cities from dust. No oil, no infinite wealth, just courage. I could have learned, copied, collaborated. Instead, I chose envy and rage.

Anti-Jewish obsession. I could have accepted Jews as neighbors. I could have said: "Two nations, two states." Instead, I repeat: "From the river to the sea." Instead of displaying honor, hospitality, and rich Arab culture, I showed only the culture of the sword: anger, extremism, and blood. Instead of shouting salaam (peace) to Israelis, I shouted death to the Jews. And then I pretend to be surprised when Israelis don't trust me, when they're angry, disappointed, and convinced I don't want coexistence at all.

Responsibility. I blame Israel for everything. Always. My leaders steal billions? Israel's fault. Hamas fires rockets from hospitals? Israel's fault. I glorify death over life? Israel's fault. Responsibility isn't my strong suit.

I am Palestinian.
I could have built a nation, many times. I chose rejection, corruption, and endless war. I could have lived in peace with Israel, but I chose to live in the shadow of its destruction.

So yes, I am a victim. But too often, I am a victim of my own leaders, my own choices, and my own refusal to let go of hate.

And that, dear reader, is the tragedy no one wants to admit."

Diesel deal with Putin:
US President Donald Trump never saw himself as a supporter of Ukraine attacked by Russia. He promised to end the war - as an intermediary. But so far it has not happened.
Now Trump has made agreements with Kremlin leader Vladimir Putin and is apparently approaching him.

The Geopolitical shift:

The bad news for Ukraine from the USA followed blow after blow in recent weeks: Only the US president surprisingly announced a diesel deal after a phone call with Putin. Russia will provide hundreds of thousands of tons of diesel for the United States and the world market. The US temporarily lifted sanctions against Russian diesel. A week later, Trump also suspended planned new sanctions against Russia shortly before they came into force. These aimed to curb Russian oil and gas exports more strongly.He called for the suspension of sanctions with „national interest" of the United States. He repeatedly blamed Ukrainian President Zelensky for a worldwide diesel shortage and called on him to stop attacks on Russian refineries.

For several days, the Ukrainian military has also been complaining about a throttling of the militarily important satellite Internet Starlink. This belongs to the corporate kingdom of US tech billionaire Elon Musk, but the military-used special function Starshield is controlled by the Pentagon, according to his information. Since taking office, Trump has made several U-turns in the Ukraine war in contrast to the previous US government.

In Ukrainian Zelensky government the horror of Trump is great. The Ukrainian energy system is in trouble even before winter has begun. Zelensky also gives up the restraint these days, with which he otherwise reacted to Trump. At the same time, he stressed that he would be ready to continue in talks with the USA at any time.

Without US support now, the situation is becoming difficult for Ukraine's defenders in many areas, and Europe can hardly make up for the shortfalls:
-Reconnaissance Data: According to Ukrainian reports, the US provides crucial data on potential Russian attacks—such as jet launches or missile preparation—as well as targeting intelligence for Ukrainian counterattacks (troop movements, command centers, and air defense positions). While some intelligence now comes from European sources, such as France, it does not fully replace US capabilities.
- Starlink: The Ukrainian military relies heavily on SpaceX's satellite internet for field communications and drone operations, including intercepting Russian combat drones and striking military targets in occupied territories. A loss of this communication system would directly threaten the frontline, and Europe currently has no equivalent alternative to step in.
- Air Defense: The US-made Patriot air defense system offers the best protection against Russian ballistic missiles, but PAC interceptor missiles are in short supply. With limited direct US deliveries, supporters like Germany are supplying ammunition from their own arsenals or sourcing rockets piecemeal from other nations' militaries.
- US Arms Purchases: Under Trump, direct US military aid has ceased, but NATO allies continue purchasing US weaponry for Ukraine through the PURL program. Although this program is currently active, there is ongoing risk that Trump could alter this policy.

What will the continuation of the war look like for Moscow?

Sanctions crumble, revenues from diesel exports flow into the war treasury. After long-term relationships, a mutually beneficial cooperation is beckoned, as the responsible Kremlin representative Kirill Dmitryev announced and European support could be shaky, for example by an election victory of the right in France in 2027.

Last Call – Facing Reality
A concept for real peace negotiations involving China, India, or Turkey. The Kremlin rejects a ceasefire, fearing a regrouping of Ukrainian forces in contested areas.

VICTOR DAVIS HANSON: What might have saved Gaza?

After October 7, 2023 
Could the destruction of Gaza after October 7 have been avoided? The answer is yes—had Hamas so wished. 

Critics of Israel consistently fail to offer any viable alternative to the Israeli ground effort to destroy the Hamas mass murderers

First, if the Hamas leadership had simply complied with Israeli demands to (a) return the 251 hostages and (b) surrender the architects and perpetrators of the massacre of some 1,200 Israelis, the Israelis would not have had to fight Hamas in the streets and tunnels of Gaza.

Note how critics of Israel consistently fail to offer any viable alternative to the Israeli ground effort to destroy the Hamas mass murderers.

Nor do Israel’s enemies ever bother to explain why Hamas did not return its hostages and give up the perpetrators of October 7. 

Why did nobody expect the International Criminal Court or the UN to have the slightest effect when they ineffectually interceded to demand the return of the hostages and issued arrest warrants for the “war criminals” of Hamas?

The answer, of course, is that there was no more likelihood of them getting Hamas to cooperate than there was of the defunct League of Nations convincing Hitler to stop the killing of Jews or the UN persuading Pol Pot to stop murdering Cambodians. 

And it is likely that many anti-Israeli UN members silently approved of the murders. Moreover, there is no evidence that most Gazans objected to the terrorism. Indeed, large numbers joined in when possible. 

More than 2,000 civilians tagged along in hopes of killing, raping, torturing, and looting with impunity. 

And when corpses and hostages appeared in the trucks of the returning Hamas murderers, the killers had to protect their prizes from their own even more bloodthirsty people back home, who sought to beat and spit on already dead and wounded Jews. 

Imagine: the killers had to protect their hostages from an even more bloodthirsty “civilian” mob.

Second, Hamas didn’t just refuse to stand down and hand over the hostages and culpable terrorists to the Israelis. 

Far from seeking peace, Hamas and Hezbollah spent the 20 days between the slaughter of Oct. 7 and the Israeli ground forces’ entry into Gaza launching thousands of missiles, rockets, and drones at civilians in Israel (barrages that would exceed, within a year, 25,000 launches).

Third, the death toll in Gaza would have been far lower had the killers of Oct. 7 helped their own civilians keep clear of combat zones. 

Far fewer Gazans would have died had Hamas not deliberately situated its tunnel exits and entrances beneath private homes, hospitals, mosques, and schools.

The IDF gave warnings to civilians and even texted thousands of Gazans with instructions to evacuate northern Gaza and keep clear of the Hamas terrorists who were using their own citizens as human shields. 

And why did Hamas do this, if not in the correct belief that the Israelis would avoid those human shields in a way that Hamas itself would never have avoided Israeli human shields had the situation been reversed?

Worse, Hamas had even less respect for its own citizens than did the supposedly genocidal Israeli enemy. 

It used noncombatants, hospitals, and mosques as shields because it was certain that Israel would show them more deference by not bombing them than Hamas itself showed by putting them in harm’s way.

What would have happened had Hamas (after jubilantly returning home with hostages, trophy corpses, and loot) immediately insisted that Gazan citizens descend into its 310 miles of subterranean sanctuaries to use them as air-raid shelters — while Hamas fighters battled the enemy above ground?

Could anyone imagine British soldiers during the Blitz sneaking into subway tunnels and hiding, Hamas-style, while British civilians fought above and braved the bombing?

text:
The undercover footage from 2020 still stands as a direct admission. A man in Minneapolis showed a car packed with what he called absentee ballots—hundreds in one haul—and stated that people working with Ilhan Omar and other candidates had filled them out. Cash was exchanged. Elders were visited. Blank or open ballots left the building. Minnesota law is clear: an agent may return the sealed absentee ballot envelopes of not more than three voters in any election (Minn. Stat. § 203B.08). Possessing and moving 300 is not assistance. It is illegal harvesting.

Federal law is equally clear. 18 U.S.C. § 597 makes it a crime to make, offer, solicit, or accept any expenditure to influence a person to vote, withhold a vote, or vote for or against a candidate. Both the person offering money and the person accepting it can be charged. The statute does not require the vote to actually change. The offer or acceptance with the intent to influence is enough. Cash for ballots, or cash for the act of turning over a ballot, fits the statute. No prosecution followed the 2020 video. Sources later walked back parts of the story. Editing was alleged. That does not erase the on-camera statements or the physical ballots in the trunk.

The same networks continue to fight every measure that would require proof of citizenship or regular roll maintenance. They label basic security as disenfranchisement while the harvesting continues. Noncitizen voting remains illegal in every state for federal elections. Documented cases exist, but the scale is disputed. The pattern of resistance to verification is not disputed. The SAVE Act (and its rebranded versions) would require documentary proof of citizenship for registration in federal elections. It has passed the House more than once and remains blocked in the Senate. States that already require it show that the administrative burden is real, but excluding noncitizens is the point.

**Solution**  
Pass the SAVE Act in the Senate. Mandate citizenship verification for federal registration. Enforce Minnesota’s existing three-ballot limit with audits of large-volume returns and prosecutions under both state and federal law. Require signed agent declarations that list the voter and the agent. Prohibit compensation calculated by the number of ballots collected. Clean the rolls with the same rigor applied to any other high-risk transaction. The alternative is the continued untraceable movement of ballots and continued cash exchanges that federal statute already forbids.

The pattern is the same one that treats election administration as a management problem rather than a constraint on power. Limits that already exist are ignored. Verification is opposed. The result is not greater participation. It is reduced traceability and the normalization of practices federal law already prohibits. The remedy is enforcement of the statutes already on the books, plus the addition of citizenship proof that the current system has never required at the federal registration stage.

Carver previously served as Microsoft's Senior Director of AI Construction and Site Development, where his responsibilities included the company's Fairwater campus in Wisconsin. His experience overseeing hyperscale construction programs gives Soluna direct exposure to the technical, procurement and scheduling standards used by some of the industry's most demanding customers.

For a company seeking to move from Bitcoin hosting into purpose-built AI infrastructure, that experience is relevant to its ability to turn proposed capacity into facilities that customers can actually occupy.

The investment implications reach beyond construction schedules.

Electricity availability increasingly influences where hyperscalers deploy capital, which developers can secure long-term leases and how lenders assess the probability that a project will begin generating cash flow on schedule.

A campus capable of supporting commercial AI operations in 2028 may have a considerable economic advantage over one facing an uncertain 2031 grid connection, even where the latter offers greater theoretical capacity.

Earlier delivery can bring forward rental income, reduce exposure to changing hardware requirements and give tenants greater confidence in their deployment plans. Those advantages can influence both lease negotiations and the financing terms available to infrastructure developers.

For Soluna, this creates the possibility that its existing electrical assets, previously established interconnection positions and relatively advanced development work will attract greater attention as hyperscalers become more selective about delivery risk.

There is no indication that Microsoft's withdrawal from the Essex project is connected to Soluna, nor should a British computing requirement automatically be viewed as demand that can relocate to Texas. The more important development is the potential shift in how customers and investors compare competing infrastructure projects.

Soluna's remaining milestones are substantial. Kati 2 needs a binding customer agreement, project financing, completion of its supplemental power infrastructure and successful construction of an AI facility far more complex than its existing Bitcoin operations. Dorothy 3 has an even longer development path ahead.

Yet the company has already assembled several of the assets that are becoming increasingly difficult to obtain: operating sites, access to renewable generation, established interconnection infrastructure, development land and a team with direct hyperscale construction experience.

Microsoft's reported decision at Nscale underscores the commercial consequences of electricity infrastructure failing to keep pace with AI deployment schedules. For developers targeting 2027–2028, it may also improve the competitive environment at a particularly important moment.

As the industry moves from announcing gigawatts of proposed capacity to financing and occupying actual facilities, investors may increasingly distinguish between developers with ambitious long-term pipelines and those positioned to deliver usable megawatts within the next two years.

Soluna's opportunity is to turn that timing advantage into signed leases, funded construction and operating AI capacity. If it succeeds, the value of its existing power infrastructure could look substantially different from how the market assesses it today.

text:
$SLNH | Microsoft's Nscale Withdrawal Puts a Premium on AI Infrastructure That Can Deliver Power Before 2030

Microsoft's reported withdrawal from Nscale's planned data center in Essex offers a revealing glimpse into how the economics of AI infrastructure are changing. The British company's proposed facility in Loughton has encountered repeated delays, and electricity network authorities reportedly do not expect to supply the site with power until the 2030s.

The Telegraph first reported Microsoft's decision, with Bloomberg and Reuters subsequently covering the development. Although Microsoft has not publicly explained its withdrawal, the problems surrounding the project's electricity connection raise an increasingly consequential question for the industry: how much is future data center capacity worth when a customer cannot be certain when it will become operational?

The implications extend well beyond Nscale. Hyperscalers are committing enormous amounts of capital to AI computing infrastructure, frequently planning deployments around successive generations of increasingly powerful and expensive accelerators. Those investments are sensitive to timing. A data center that becomes operational in 2028 can support years of workloads before another facility awaiting grid access in 2031 receives its first megawatt.

For customers making long-term infrastructure commitments, several years of delay can materially change the financial assumptions behind a project. GPUs depreciate, new architectures improve performance per watt, and the opportunity to generate revenue from current-generation computing equipment does not wait for utilities to complete their transmission upgrades.

This increasingly favors developers with credible near-term power delivery schedules over those whose principal assets remain land, development plans and distant interconnection dates.

Soluna Holdings (NASDAQ: SLNH) has been positioning itself around precisely this constraint.

The company's approach differs from conventional data center development, where securing a suitable site can be followed by years of negotiations over electricity supply and grid capacity. Soluna develops computing infrastructure alongside existing renewable generation, using behind-the-meter arrangements to access electricity close to its source while retaining the ability to interact with the wider grid.

That model has already been deployed commercially, although Soluna's operating facilities currently serve primarily Bitcoin-related computing rather than high-density AI workloads.

In September, Soluna completed the final 14 MW of Project Kati 1 in Willacy County, Texas, bringing the campus to its full 83 MW operating capacity and increasing the company's total energized computing portfolio to approximately 206 MW. According to Soluna, every phase of Kati 1 was delivered on schedule, with infrastructure costs remaining within budget.

The achievement matters beyond the additional operating capacity. It provides evidence of the company's ability to build, energize and manage substantial computing loads within the Texas electricity market, a record that becomes relevant when prospective AI customers evaluate execution risk.

September also brought a significant development on the regulatory side. ERCOT conditionally classified the full 166 MW Kati campus and 100 MW at Project Dorothy as Base Load under its Batch Zero framework, preserving their respective interconnection positions subject to verification.

These classifications cover 266 MW of capacity across the two campuses, including existing operating facilities. At Kati, 83 MW is associated with the planned AI expansion at Kati 2. They do not mean that 266 MW of new AI infrastructure is ready for immediate deployment, or that the larger development pipeline has secured all the electricity it requires.

Sako was born in the city of Zakho, Iraq, on 4 July 1948.[3] He comes from an ethnic Assyrian family of the Chaldean Catholic Church that has roots in a religious community that has had a presence in the city of his birth since the 5th century AD.[4]

Revelation 17:15 That is, as unconstant and variable as the waters. Upon this foundation sitteth this harlot as Queen, a vain person upon that which is vain.

Revelation 17:17 A reason rendered from the chief efficient cause, which is the providence of God, by which alone S. John by inversion of order affirmeth to have come to pass, both that the Kings should execute upon the harlot, that which pleased God, and which he declared in the verse next beforegoing: and also that by one consent and counsel, they should give their kingdom unto the beast, etc., verses 13, 14. Biography
Early life
Sako was born in the city of Zakho, Iraq, on 4 July 1948.[3] He comes from an ethnic Assyrian family of the Chaldean Catholic Church that has roots in a religious community that has had a presence in the city of his birth since the 5th century AD.[4]

He completed his early studies in Mosul and then attended the Dominican-run Saint Jean’s Seminary there.

He was ordained a priest on 1 June 1974 and filled his first pastoral assignment at the Cathedral of Mosul until 1979. He then earned a doctorate in Eastern patrology at the Pontifical Oriental Institute. When denied a license to teach because he was only qualified for religious instruction, he earned a second doctorate in history from the Sorbonne in Paris.[5] With this he secured his teaching license and was able to provide religious instruction. From 1997 to 2002 he was rector of the Patriarchal Seminary in Baghdad. He then returned to Mosul and guided the parish of Perpetual Help for a year.[6][7]

Biography
Early life
Sako was born in the city of Zakho, Iraq, on 4 July 1948.[3] He comes from an ethnic Assyrian family of the Chaldean Catholic Church that has roots in a religious community that has had a presence in the city of his birth since the 5th century AD.[4]

He completed his early studies in Mosul and then attended the Dominican-run Saint Jean’s Seminary there.

He was ordained a priest on 1 June 1974 and filled his first pastoral assignment at the Cathedral of Mosul until 1979. He then earned a doctorate in Eastern patrology at the Pontifical Oriental Institute. When denied a license to teach because he was only qualified for religious instruction, he earned a second doctorate in history from the Sorbonne in Paris.[5] With this he secured his teaching license and was able to provide religious instruction. From 1997 to 2002 he was rector of the Patriarchal Seminary in Baghdad. He then returned to Mosul and guided the parish of Perpetual Help for a year.[6][7]
